Description: The cost of generating one new install.
Formula: CPI = Total campaign spend / Number of app installs

Description: D1: The percentage of new users who return to the game exactly one day after installing.
D7: The percentage of new users who return to the game exactly seven days after installing.
DAU: The total number of unique players who open and engage with the game in a 24-hour period.
MAU: The total number of unique players who open and engage with the game at least once within a 30-day period.
Stickiness: The ratio of daily active users to monthly active users (DAU / MAU)
ARPDAU: The average revenue generated per active user in a single day (Total Daily Revenue / DAU).
ARPPU: The average revenue generated specifically from users who made a purchase (Total Revenue / Paying Users).
ARPU: The average revenue generated from all users over a specific period (Total Revenue / Total Users).
LTV: The total estimated revenue a single user will generate throughout their entire time playing the game.
ROAS: A measure of advertising effectiveness calculated as revenue earned divided by the amount spent on marketing.
